title: Quotient-page descent retaining prescribed CE bicomplexes
statement: For all schemes X and bounded-below complexes K of abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], prescribe augmented CE bicomplexes I(X,K),a(X,K) [def-sp-double-complex-total] with individual lower bounds in complex degree, injective object, cycle, boundary and homology terms and quasi-isomorphic augmented columns [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. There exist simultaneous termwise hypercohomology presentations P(X,K) [def-weil-pbc-termwise-hypercohomology-presentation] retaining P(X,K).I=I(X,K), and actual quotient realizations e [lem-weil-pbc-ce-stationary-page-naturality]. Given f:Y→X [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], v:f⁻¹K→L, a bicomplex comparison φ:f⁻¹P(X,K).I→P(Y,L).I commuting with the augmentations in resolution degree zero, and a sheaf-total map u with the nonnegative diagonal summand equations displayed in the Lean statement, assume the conjugated sections map b [lem-weil-pbc-ce-total-sections-comparison] restricts to every filtration step. Then b induces a spectral-sequence morphism N on quotient representatives. Under the signed first-page identifications N is Sheaf.H.map(v.f q) after cohomologyMap [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. This asserts neither the existence of φ nor that of u or its filtration restrictions.

source.place: Tag 015J, Lemma 13.21.3, prescribed CE resolution and first-page computation; Tag 015K, Remark 13.21.4; Tag 012K, Lemmas 12.24.2 and 12.24.4. Steps 1 and 3 of lem-weil-pbc-ce-coherent-prescribed-resolutions.

proof.text: Choose prescribed normalized presentations and their first-page computation. This supplies P, delta, j, equality of the prescribed bicomplexes, normalization of successor comparisons and the first-page criterion for an individual page map.

Apply filtered canonical page descent to the supplied conjugated sections map and its filtration restrictions. Evaluate j in each bidegree to define the quotient realization e. The descent theorem supplies a spectral-sequence morphism N and the representative equations.
Apply the first-page criterion to N.hom 1 using the r=1 specialization of its representative equation, and pair this equation with its representative action at all positive pages.

proof_origin.place: Split steps 1 and 3 into prescribed normalized first-page assembly; prove step 2 generically without global filtration finiteness, and combine its representative equation with the first-page criterion.

theorem exists_etaleCE_prescribed_quotient_page_descent
    (I : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
      (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})),
      HomologicalComplex₂ (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
    (a : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
      (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})),
      ((CochainComplex.single₀
        (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})).mapHomologicalComplex
         (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K.obj ⟶ I X K)
    (hbelow : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
      (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})),
      ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ s : ℤ, s < b → IsZero ((I X K).X s))
    (hrows : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
      (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
      (s : ℤ), QuasiIso ((a X K).f s))
    (hterms : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
      (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
      (s : ℤ) (r : ℕ), Injective (((I X K).X s).X r))
    (hhorizontal : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
      (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
      (s : ℤ) (r : ℕ),
      Injective (((I X K).cycles s).X r) ∧
      Injective ((image ((I X K).d (s - 1) s)).X r) ∧
      Injective (((I X K).homology s).X r))
    (hquasi : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
      (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
      (s : ℤ),
      QuasiIso (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap (a X K) s) ∧
      QuasiIso (image.map (Arrow.homMk' ((a X K).f (s - 1)) ((a X K).f s)
        ((a X K).comm (s - 1) s))) ∧
      QuasiIso (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (a X K) s)) :
    ∃ (P : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})),
        EtaleTermwiseHypercohomology X K)
      (e : ∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})),
        EtaleCEQuotientRealization (P X K)),
      (∀ (X : Scheme.{uNatural})
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})),
        (P X K).I = I X K) ∧
      ∀ {X Y : Scheme.{uNatural}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
    (L : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))
    (v : ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K.obj ⟶ L.obj),
      let D := P X K
      let D' := P Y L
      ∀ (φ : (((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj D.I ⟶ D'.I)
    (hφ : ∀ q : ℤ,
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f).map
          ((HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0 (K.obj.X q)).inv ≫
            (D.a.f q).f 0) ≫ (φ.f q).f 0 =
        v.f q ≫
          (HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0 (L.obj.X q)).inv ≫
            (D'.a.f q).f 0)
    (u : ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj D.sheafTotal ⟶ D'.sheafTotal)
    (hu : ∀ (m : ℕ) (q n : ℤ) (h : (m : ℤ) + q = n),
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f).map
            ((HomologicalComplex.extendXIso
              (((𝟭 (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})).mapHomologicalComplex
                (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj (D.I.X q))
              ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat (i := m) (i' := (m : ℤ)) rfl).inv ≫
                (((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor
                  (𝟭 (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))).obj
                    D.I).flip).ιTotal (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (m : ℤ) q n h) ≫ u.f n =
          (φ.f q).f m ≫
            (HomologicalComplex.extendXIso
              (((𝟭 (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1})).mapHomologicalComplex
                (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj (D'.I.X q))
              ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat (i := m) (i' := (m : ℤ)) rfl).inv ≫
                (((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor
                  (𝟭 (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}))).obj
                    D'.I).flip).ιTotal (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (m : ℤ) q n h),
      let b := D.totalSectionsIso.hom ≫ ceSectionsLift f u ≫ D'.totalSectionsIso.inv
      (∀ q : ℤ, ∃ s : (D.L.step q : CochainComplex AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} ℤ) ⟶
          (D'.L.step q : CochainComplex AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} ℤ),
        s ≫ (D'.L.step q).arrow = (D.L.step q).arrow ≫ b) →
      ∃ N : D.sequence ⟶ D'.sequence,
        (∀ (p : ℕ) (q : ℤ),
        (N.hom 1).f (q, (p : ℤ)) ≫ (D'.firstPageIso p q).hom =
          (D.firstPageIso p q).hom ≫
            AddCommGrpCat.ofHom ((Sheaf.H.map (v.f q) p).comp
              (cohomologyMap f (K.obj.X q) p))) ∧
        EtaleCEPageMapOnRepresentatives D D' (e X K) (e Y L) b N
